item.title: PickerPal Products provides full case pick module protection to protect employees from falls.
item.description: PickerPal has two independent, spring-loaded arms that are self closing, which is preferred by OSHA. 3 arms are used when a kick plate is required. OSHA states that when an employee is within 4’ of the edge, the area changes from a pallet position to a, “walking/working surface,” which requires a kick plate or a third arm.
